title: Love love love!
text: I get a few other subscription boxes but this is the one I really look forward to and is my favorite by far!!  I feel like the first few months there were a lot of repeat items and I wasn't sure if I wanted to continue.  But because I really liked what I was getting, I did.  Glad I did because I love the variety and the fun snacks that I never knew were out there!
label: positive
